title: authentik blueprint (permissive, local)
description: Deliberately loose schema for authentik blueprints. Exists to solve a specific editor problem, NOT to validate blueprints properly - use `ak apply_blueprint` for that. Two failure modes it avoids: (1) with NO schema, the VS Code YAML extension auto-matches an unrelated schema from SchemaStore and reports 'Missing property spec_version' / 'Property entries is not allowed'; (2) with authentik's OWN published schema, every !Find / !KeyOf line is reported as 'Incorrect type. Expected string', because that schema describes the resolved API shape (authorization_flow is type string/uuid) and contains zero references to the template tags. This schema checks only the outer envelope and leaves entry contents unconstrained, so the tags pass. Reference it with a modeline: # yaml-language-server: $schema=./blueprint.schema.json

version.description: Blueprint format version. authentik currently uses 1.
